description: Integrations and AI Agents: Use when you need to know which CRM Connector account is connected, for example right after connecting or to tell two connected accounts apart. Returns an opaque id, the organisation name and the email address of the signed in person, plus a short note on what to do next: setting up the first integration (with what the person said they want, when they said it), finishing a setup that waits for a plan, or what needs attention, followed by what else the plugin offers in its two products: integrations between two systems and AI Agents inside one system. Not for the integrations themselves or their sync results (use list_integrations and get_integration_health).
name: get_profile

email.description: The email address the person signs in with.

id.description: Opaque profile identifier, unique within this app and unchanged across token refresh, reconnection and display changes. Never reassigned to another profile.

name.description: The organisation the account belongs to.

nickname.description: The organisation and email together, to tell accounts apart.

title: Show the connected account
